name: CIMB
recent: CIMB 近期主要出现大股东 EPF 与 KWAP 的持股变动申报，以及一次 ESOS 新股上市。新闻焦点集中在伊斯兰财富管理业务扩张，包括推出数字财富平台并设定 2030 年管理资产增长目标。
notable: CIMB 推出伊斯兰数字财富管理平台，目标 2030 年管理资产增长。
公司通过 ESOS 发行 43,500 股新股，发行价每股 RM5.41，并于 2026 年 11 月 16 日上市。
EPF 于 2026 年 10 月 31 日再减持 320 万股 CIMB 股份。
risks: EPF 与 KWAP 近期多次申报持股变动，显示大股东持股持续调整。
EPF 在 10 月底进一步减持 320 万股。

recent_en: CIMB recently saw substantial shareholder filings from EPF and KWAP, along with a listing of new ESOS shares. News focus is on Islamic wealth management expansion, including a digital wealth platform launch and 2030 AUM growth targets.
notable_en: CIMB launched an Islamic digital wealth management platform targeting AUM growth by 2030.
The company issued 43,500 new shares under its ESOS at RM5.41 per share, listed on 16 Nov 2026.
EPF disposed of another 3.2 million CIMB shares on 31 Oct 2026.
risks_en: EPF and KWAP have made multiple recent filings on changes in their shareholdings, indicating ongoing adjustments by major shareholders.
EPF further disposed of 3.2 million shares at the end of October.
earnings_en: 2Q 2026 revenue was MYR 5,573,143,000, up 2.6% QoQ but down 0.4% YoY; net income was MYR 1,938,265,000, up 1.1% QoQ and 2.6% YoY; net margin was 34.8% versus 35.3% in the prior quarter.
